Title: Azure Stack is partnering with Aware Group to offer new solutions

Body.Content:
Microsoft is expanding the Azure Stack ISV and partner ecosystem, announcing new partnerships with solution availability in summer 2020, including offerings from Aware Group. Aware Group, which builds Internet of Things (IoT) modules that use AI to detect anomalies and perform noise classification, is delivering modules and solutions tailored to the specific needs of industry verticals.

Learn more
